[[File:Perlote_trees.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] in a grove of perlote trees.]]
'''Perlote trees''' were [[Tree/Legends|trees]] located only in the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was beneath these trees that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established an underground [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] for [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] to create the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>
